tagline: Leading European aerospace manufacturer with global supply chain spanning commercial aircraft, defense and space, and helicopter solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Airbus operates a global supply chain composed of thousands of suppliers, with a majority based in Europe and OECD countries, supporting its three major segments (Commercial Aircraft, Defence and Space, Helicopters) and its decarbonization strategy

kpis.name: Global Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of full-time employees across all global operations
kpis.description: Airbus SE employs approximately 134,000 people across its global operations in support of its three major business segments

kpis.name: Tier-1 Suppliers Count
kpis.explanation: Number of direct suppliers with whom Airbus has supply contracts
kpis.description: Airbus works with thousands of suppliers worldwide, including raw materials, engines, systems, and aerospace structural components

kpis.name: Australian & New Zealand Supply Base
kpis.explanation: Number of approved suppliers operating in Australia and New Zealand
kpis.description: Airbus Australia Pacific Ltd has over 1,500 approved suppliers, of which 85% are based in Australia or New Zealand and the remainder primarily in Europe

kpis.name: Canadian Operations Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in Airbus's Canadian operations
kpis.description: Airbus Helicopters Canada Ltd (250 employees in Fort Erie, Ontario), Airbus Atlantic Canada group (600 employees in Mirabel, Quebec), and Airbus Canada Limited Partnership (3,500 employees) total approximately 4,350 employees

kpis.name: Regional Procurement Offices
kpis.explanation: Number of regional procurement offices established to support local sourcing initiatives
kpis.description: Airbus has established 5 regional procurement offices in North America (Herndon, Virginia), India (Bangalore), Asia-Pacific (Singapore), China (Beijing), and Africa/Middle East (Dubai)

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €134.94 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €11.02 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €14.13 Bn in the latest year

risks.title: Critical dependency on Airbus Single-Aisle
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned 4 times in Item 1A; intense language on 'ratensteigerung' and operational impacts; stable but structural trend; high weight as Aerostructures generates CHF 268M in revenue dependent on Airbus A320

risks.title: Operational challenges and capacity overruns
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited as main cause of EBIT decline (-10.8%); direct language 'operativen Herausforderungen'; upward trend (worsening); high weight as it affects overall profitability

risks.title: Customer concentration - VBS (Swiss Ministry of Defense)
risks.score_rationale: VBS represents 30% of revenue (down from 31%); referred to as 'wichtigster und grösster Einzelkunde'; neutral language but structural; stable trend; political regulation risk

risks.title: Swiss export restrictions and regulatory compliance
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned: 'strikten Schweizer Exportbestimmungen' limit competitiveness vs international peers; direct language on competitive disadvantage; stable but structural trend; major weight for international growth

risks.title: Litigation risk - overbilling to VBS
risks.score_rationale: Media report explicitly referenced; additional EFK audit commissioned; cautious language but indicative of reputational risk; new trend (2018); moderate weight but politically sensitive

risks.title: Complexity and costs of separation (Entflechtung)
risks.score_rationale: Estimated costs CHF 70M (CHF 50M in 2019); described as 'grundlegend'; neutral language but clear financial impact; new trend (decision 2018); moderate weight but temporary

risks.title: Volatility of European defense budgets
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in outlook: 'wachsenden Verteidigungsbudgets' but 'nur beschränkt profitieren'; moderate language; stable trend; low weight as RUAG does not participate in major European defense programs
